message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzzing/csv_parsing.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":17,"var":"Data/Size","code":"std::string_view input_col{(const char*)Data, Size};","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped as the CSV input buffer without validation."},
  {"step":2,"file":"fuzzing/csv_parsing.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":19,"var":"obj","code":"glz::read_csv<glz::colwise>(obj, input_col);","note":"The fuzz target forwards the raw input into the column-wise CSV parser for the vulnerable type."},
  {"step":3,"file":"include/glaze/csv/read.hpp","function":"from<CSV, T>::op","line":278,"var":"value","code":"if constexpr (!Opts.append_arrays) { value.clear(); }","note":"The parser starts by clearing the destination vector of structs before repopulating it from CSV rows."},
  {"step":4,"file":"include/glaze/csv/read.hpp","function":"from<CSV, T>::op","line":288,"var":"headers","code":"auto headers = read_column_wise_keys(ctx, it, end);","note":"The first CSV row is interpreted as column headers and used to derive member indices."},
  {"step":5,"file":"include/glaze/csv/read.hpp","function":"from<CSV, T>::op","line":320,"var":"struct_value","code":"U struct_value{};","note":"Each data row is parsed into a fresh struct instance whose members are filled from the CSV columns."},
  {"step":6,"file":"include/glaze/csv/read.hpp","function":"from<CSV, T>::op","line":330,"var":"member","code":"parse<CSV>::op<Opts>(member, ctx, it, end);","note":"For each header-mapped column, the parser dispatches into the selected struct member parser."},
  {"step":7,"file":"include/glaze/csv/read.hpp","function":"from<CSV, T>::op","line":153,"var":"value","code":"value.clear();","note":"When the selected member is a string-like field, parsing resets the string before copying bytes from the CSV field."},
  {"step":8,"file":"include/glaze/csv/read.hpp","function":"from<CSV, T>::op","line":217,"var":"*it","code":"while (it != end && *it != ',' && *it != '\\n' && *it != '\\r') { value.push_back(*it); ++it; }","note":"The unquoted-field path copies attacker-controlled bytes into the string until a delimiter is seen."},
  {"step":9,"file":"include/glaze/csv/read.hpp","function":"from<CSV, T>::op","line":228,"var":"member[row][index]","code":"parse<CSV>::op<Opts>(member[row][index], ctx, it, end);","note":"The sink is the nested array element access driven by CSV header indices and row count; malformed shapes can make this access go out of bounds."}
]
EOF
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/glaze/tests/csv_test/csv_test.cpp /workspace/candidate_trace.json
